user_query: I want to browse through the history of images I uploaded using the Web Image Storage tool. Fetch the first 3 pages, each containing 10 images. Additionally, show me the list of images I uploaded using the Image CDN tool, starting from page 7.

TaskList.description: Fetch the first page of images from the Web Image Storage tool, containing 10 images.
Fetch the second page of images from the Web Image Storage tool, containing 10 images.
Fetch the third page of images from the Web Image Storage tool, containing 10 images.
Fetch the list of images uploaded using the Image CDN tool, starting from page 7.
